bag_wtp_plan_run = {
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	# **Nothing is re-read from CMM here any more.** The caps, the rights tick and
	# «на конец» were settings on the mod page and had to be copied into globals
	# at the top of every run; they are controls in the plan's own window now and
	# write their globals themselves.
	bag_wtp_collect_candidates = yes
	bag_wtp_rebuild_browse = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_prepare = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_score = yes

		limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_rights }
		bag_wtp_plan_place_rights = yes
	}
	bag_wtp_plan_set_quota = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_place_scarce = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_allocate = yes
	# **И житницы, последними.** Их комнаты в раздаче не участвуют вовсе, и
	# домики, которые сюда встанут, ни с кем за места не спорили: круг ходит
	# только по помеченным локациям и ставит то, что растит еду или сам РГО.
	bag_wtp_plan_fill_granaries = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_rank = yes
	# **A fresh plan is its own baseline.** «Показать изменения» right after one is
	# empty, which is the true answer: nothing has been edited yet, and everything
	# after this is measured against what the formula produced.
	bag_wtp_edit_save = yes
	cmf_log = { action = bag_wtp_log_plan }
}

# плане стоит домик, который не доступен мне по уровню -- мне не показывается. Но
# я хочу, чтобы мне показывался его аналог более низкого уровня». Ступени лестницы
# игра называет сама (`obsolete` в `building_types`), а «доступна ли ступень»
# спрашивается `can_build_building` **в скоупе страны** -- именно она отвечает за
# продвижения, как и у `_avail_<n>`.
#
# **Почему числом в глобалке, а не вопросом на месте.** Фильтру списка достаётся

# ответ надо посчитать заранее там, где страна есть, -- здесь.
#

# -- фильтр покажет ступень ниже, чем мог бы; это единственная цена.

# Переключить режим житницы для этой локации.
#
# **Переменная CM пишется по-прежнему, и это не рудимент.** Мод её и читает
# (`_is_granary`), и CM, если он у кого-то стоит, увидит ту же пометку; имя,
# которого нет, ломается не там, где его ищут, а переменную можно писать в
# пустоту. Модификатор `cm_auto_food_locked_location` намеренно не ставится.
#
# **В окне плана нажатие только помечает, в редакторе -- меняет сразу.** Его
# слово 2026-09-13: «если я жму её в окне "общего плана", то чтобы получить
# изменения -- нужно нажать пересчитать… если я нажму на эту кнопку в режиме
# редактора -- изменения должны произойти сразу же, т.е. исчезнуть из локации
# домики плана и встать домики житницы». Кнопка одна на оба окна -- ряд плана
# общий, -- поэтому решает то, открыт ли редактор.
# Scope: country, ждёт scope:wtp_location

			limit = { has_variable = cm_auto_food_location_enabled }

# **Снос всего производственного, чего план тут не хочет.**
#
# Его слово, 2026-09-09: «в локации 2 здания подходят и стоит там ещё штук 10
# производственных зданий, которые не подходят. При нажатии той кнопки все эти 10
# снесёт, а остальные 2 останутся. Только смотри, чтобы эта кнопка не сносила
# какие-либо другие здания.»
#
# **Трогается ровно тот список, которым план строит** -- здания
# производственных котлов и деревни, выписанные на сборке. Гарнизон, порт,
# университет и всё прочее в этот список не входят вовсе, поэтому «случайно
# снесла не то» тут невозможно по построению, а не по проверке.
#
# **Ступень лестницы считается подходящей.** План «на конец» ставит мельницу, а
# стоит мастерская: сносить её -- значит сносить то, что фильтр и автострой
# только что назвали правильным. Правило то же самое: здание остаётся, если оно
# в плане или это высшая доступная ступень того, что в плане.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_raze_loc = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = building_type:ablaq_palace
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:ablaq_palace }
				}
			}
		}
		destroy_all_buildings_of_type = building_type:ablaq_palace
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_raze_n add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_chg_seq value = global_var:bag_wtp_edit_presses }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = building_type:apothecary

# Scope: country, ждёт scope:wtp_location
bag_wtp_raze_press_loc_do = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_raze_n value = 0 }
	bag_wtp_set_bavail = yes
	scope:wtp_location = { bag_wtp_raze_loc = yes }
}

# Scope: country, ждёт scope:wtp_location -- любую локацию нужной провинции
bag_wtp_raze_press_prov_do = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_raze_n value = 0 }
	bag_wtp_set_bavail = yes
	scope:wtp_location = { province_definition = { save_scope_as = bag_wtp_cm_prov } }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = { province_definition = { this = scope:bag_wtp_cm_prov } }
		bag_wtp_raze_loc = yes
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_raze_press_all_do = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_raze_n value = 0 }
	bag_wtp_set_bavail = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		bag_wtp_raze_loc = yes
	}
}

# **Одна отмашка на галочки автостроя Construction Manager, и больше ничего.**
#
# Владелец, 2026-09-09, после первой версии: «я не хочу, чтобы мод делал
# что-либо каждый месяц… Всё, что это делает — включает 4 кнопки у каждого из
# этих зданий в их локации. 1 раз она это делает. Просто включает их галочки 1
# раз… А дальше уже CM сам решает когда строить, что строить. Только ссылка на
# другие ссылки.» Месячный лист и очередь `cm_q_ungated_*` из первой версии
# убраны целиком.
#
# **Галочка -- это две переменные CM на локации**, и обе пишутся напрямую, без
# единого его имени: имя, которого нет, ломается не там, где его ищут, а
# переменную можно писать в пустоту. Форма списана с `cm_apply_auto_expand_toggle`
# (CM 2.2.12): в обычном режиме тип лежит в `cm_auto_expand_registered_building_types`
# локации; если страна включила его массово (`cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types`),
# логика переворачивается и «выключено» значит «тип в
# `cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types` этой локации».
#
# `_cm_off` -- направление отмашки: 1 снять, 0 поставить.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_cm_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:ablaq_palace } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_ba_ablaq_palace = 1
				OR = {
					has_building = building_type:ablaq_palace
					can_build_building = building_type:ablaq_palace
				}
			}
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_did add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types target = building_type:ablaq_palace } } }
				# Массовый режим страны: «выключено» -- это исключение локации.
				if = {
					limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_cm_off = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:ablaq_palace } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:ablaq_palace }
					}
				}
				else = { remove_list_variable = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:ablaq_palace } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_cm_off = 1 }

# кадр: строк в окне сорок, и ответ на кадр стоил бы того же, что и панель,

# **Горит ли иконка -- переменная, а не вопрос на каждом кадре.**
#
# Владелец, 2026-09-09: «иконки всегда горят так, как выглядит положение "вкл"…
# Она должна загораться и потухать». Ответ считается на нажатии и на открытии
# окна и лежит на локации: `visible` умеет читать переменную и не умеет звать
# триггер, а сорок строк, каждая со своим обходом плана на кадр, -- это ровно та
# цена, которую этот репозиторий до сих пор ищет в `panel_hitch.md`.
#
# **Считается вычитанием, а не сравнением двух переменных.** `var:x = var:y` тут
# нигде не доказан: `_cm_lall` растёт на каждую найденную галочку и убывает на
# каждую стоящую, так что «горит» -- это `_cm_lfound > 0` и `_cm_lall = 0`,
# оба против чисел.
# Scope: location

					OR = {
						is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_registered_building_types target = building_type:weapon_workshop }
						AND = {
							owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types target = building_type:weapon_workshop } }
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:weapon_workshop } }
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall subtract = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_ba_weapon_guild = 1
				OR = {
					has_building = building_type:weapon_guild
					can_build_building = building_type:weapon_guild
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lfound add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_registered_building_types target = building_type:weapon_guild }
						AND = {
							owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types target = building_type:weapon_guild } }
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:weapon_guild } }
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall subtract = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:winery } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_ba_winery = 1
				OR = {
					has_building = building_type:winery
					can_build_building = building_type:winery
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lfound add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_registered_building_types target = building_type:winery }
						AND = {
							owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types target = building_type:winery } }
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:winery } }
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall subtract = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:winery_manufactory } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_ba_winery_manufactory = 1
				OR = {
					has_building = building_type:winery_manufactory
					can_build_building = building_type:winery_manufactory
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lfound add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_registered_building_types target = building_type:winery_manufactory }
						AND = {
							owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types target = building_type:winery_manufactory } }
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:winery_manufactory } }
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall subtract = 1 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				global_var:bag_wtp_ba_winery = 1
				OR = {
					has_building = building_type:winery
					can_build_building = building_type:winery
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lfound add = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall add = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_registered_building_types target = building_type:winery }
						AND = {
							owner = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_mass_auto_expand_building_types target = building_type:winery } }
							NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cm_auto_expand_excluded_building_types target = building_type:winery } }
						}
					}
				}
				change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lall subtract = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_cm_lit
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:bag_wtp_cm_lfound > 0
			NOT = { var:bag_wtp_cm_lall > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lit value = 1 }
	}
}

# Тот же ответ для ряда провинции и для шапки. Провинция горит, когда горят все
# её локации плана; шапка -- когда горит весь план. Провинция читается со своей
# представительной локации, той же, на которой стоит её ряд.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_cm_light = {
	bag_wtp_set_bavail = yes
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		bag_wtp_cm_light_loc = yes
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_provs
		province_definition = { save_scope_as = bag_wtp_cm_prov }
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_cm_lit_prov
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_in_global_list = {
					variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
					province_definition = { this = scope:bag_wtp_cm_prov }
					var:bag_wtp_cm_lit = 1
				}
				NOT = {
					any_in_global_list = {
						variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
						province_definition = { this = scope:bag_wtp_cm_prov }
						var:bag_wtp_cm_lfound > 0
						NOT = { var:bag_wtp_cm_lit = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lit_prov value = 1 }
		}
	}
	remove_global_variable = bag_wtp_cm_lit_all
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_in_global_list = {
				variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
				var:bag_wtp_cm_lit = 1
			}
			NOT = {
				any_in_global_list = {
					variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
					var:bag_wtp_cm_lfound > 0
					NOT = { var:bag_wtp_cm_lit = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_lit_all value = 1 }
	}
}

# Пройти помеченную группу дважды: сначала посчитать, потом решить и применить.
# Scope: country, ждёт заполненный global list scope

	bag_wtp_cm_zero = yes

		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = { province_definition = { this = scope:bag_wtp_cm_prov } }
		bag_wtp_cm_scan = yes
	}

		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = { province_definition = { this = scope:bag_wtp_cm_prov } }
		bag_wtp_cm_apply = yes
	}
	bag_wtp_cm_light = yes
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_cm_zero = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_all value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_on value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_did value = 0 }
	# Что стране по зубам -- на сегодня: ступень берётся та же, что показывает
	# фишка «Из плана — сюда», иначе кнопка и список говорили бы разное.
	bag_wtp_set_bavail = yes
}

# Всё уже включено -- значит нажатие снимает. Иначе включает.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_cm_decide = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_off value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_cm_all > 0
			NOT = { global_var:bag_wtp_cm_all > global_var:bag_wtp_cm_on }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_cm_off value = 1 }
	}
}

	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn38 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn39 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_lapn40 value = 0 }

	# Every candidate made ready. **Every counter a `limit` reads has to exist
	# before the first round**: a comparison against a variable that is not there
	# is the failure that logs nothing.
	#
	# `_plan_seen` marks the province through its first candidate, so
	# `_plan_prov_locs` is one location per province -- what the row ordering
	# walks, and the only thing the plan still asks a province.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = 9999 }
		# **Продовольственный потенциал -- в переменную, а не в строку.** Он не
		# зависит от плана вовсе, только от локации, поэтому считается один раз
		# на обходе: `visible` в ряду умеет читать переменную и не умеет звать
		# значение, а сорок строк со своим счётом на кадр -- это `panel_hitch`.
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_food_pot value = bag_wtp_food_potential }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { var:bag_wtp_food_pot > 0 } }
			remove_variable = bag_wtp_food_pot
		}
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_right
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_goods
		clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_builds
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_touched target = this }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_town_row value = 1 }
		}
		else = { remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_town_row }
		# **Места житницы -- не места плана.** Комнаты, которые нельзя заполнить,
		# делят доли на всех и оставляют товары ниже потолка: ровно тот случай,
		# из-за которого 259 комнат стояли пустыми 2026-09-08. Ряд у неё остаётся,
		# РГО считается, город городом быть не перестаёт -- в счёт не идут только
		# места.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_is_granary = no }
			if = {
				limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prooms_t add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_urban }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_towns add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rooms add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prooms_r add = bag_wtp_show_plan_cap_rural }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_seen } }
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_seen value = 1 }
				}
			}
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs target = this }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provn add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# One scoring pass per good, the harvest that makes the answers comparable, and
# the count of how few places can hold it.
#
# **This is the expensive half of the mod and the reason the plan is a button of
# its own.** A single-good run reads about five methods on each candidate; this
# reads all 667 of them, 47 passes over the same ground.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_score = {
	# **Покрытие -- до всего остального.** `_rq<k>`, которым раздача выбирает
	# грамоты, читает `_cov_<товар>`, а посчитать его может только эффект: доля
	# входа спрашивает `any_location_in_province_definition`.
	#
	# **Эпоха ставится тумблером этого окна, и это не мелочь.** Проход умеет
	# считать «на сейчас» и «на конец», а из какого тумблера брать -- решает тот,
	# кто зовёт: у плана свой, у поиска по грамоте свой.
	bag_wtp_cov_age_plan = yes
	save_scope_as = bag_wtp_country
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		bag_wtp_cov_pass = yes
		# Лесенка грамот этой локации -- её читает подсказка строки плана.
		bag_wtp_rq_park = yes
		bag_wtp_rq_rank = yes
	}
	bag_wtp_score_1 = yes

# Что каждая деревня стоит на каждой локации и сколько локаций её пускают.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_village_scores = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngv1 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngv2 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngv3 value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no }
		# fishing_village: fish, naval_supplies, pottery
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb1 value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw1 value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_stands_fishing_village = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm6 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr6 > var:bag_wtp_vb1
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb1 value = var:bag_wtp_pr6 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw1 value = 6 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm39 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr39 > var:bag_wtp_vb1
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb1 value = var:bag_wtp_pr39 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw1 value = 39 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm42 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr42 > var:bag_wtp_vb1
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb1 value = var:bag_wtp_pr42 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw1 value = 42 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vw1 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngv1 add = 1 }
		}
		# forest_village: wild_game, leather, tools, weaponry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb2 value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw2 value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_stands_forest_village = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm23 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr23 > var:bag_wtp_vb2
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb2 value = var:bag_wtp_pr23 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw2 value = 23 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm36 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr36 > var:bag_wtp_vb2
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb2 value = var:bag_wtp_pr36 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw2 value = 36 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm46 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr46 > var:bag_wtp_vb2
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb2 value = var:bag_wtp_pr46 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw2 value = 46 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm47 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr47 > var:bag_wtp_vb2
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb2 value = var:bag_wtp_pr47 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw2 value = 47 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vw2 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngv2 add = 1 }
		}
		# market_village: beer, jewelry, pottery, tools, weaponry
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb3 value = -1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw3 value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_stands_market_village = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm26 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr26 > var:bag_wtp_vb3
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr26 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw3 value = 26 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm34 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr34 > var:bag_wtp_vb3
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr34 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw3 value = 34 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm42 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr42 > var:bag_wtp_vb3
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr42 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw3 value = 42 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:bag_wtp_prm46 > 0
					var:bag_wtp_pr46 > var:bag_wtp_vb3
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr46 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw3 value = 46 }
			}
			if = {

					var:bag_wtp_pr47 > var:bag_wtp_vb3
				}
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vb3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr47 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vw3 value = 47 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:bag_wtp_vw3 > 0 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngv3 add = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# clay: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng1` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_1 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		# **The two sides are "where may this building stand", not "is it a
		# village".** Thirty production buildings declare `rural_settlement` and
		# only four are villages, so the ranking's category split would leave a
		# rural location with nothing but villages to be offered.
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			# **Nothing clears the floor: take the best recipe anyway.** A location
			# no RGO helps still has to be filled, and a granted right's bundle goes
			# up whether the bonus is there or not -- the owner, 2026-09-01.
			#
			# **And it keeps its own gain, undivided.** The score already *is* how
			# much of its ceiling the ground pays: a recipe earning 4% of a possible
			# 10 comes in at 400 and is behind everything better by that alone.
			# Halving it on top counted the same fact twice and moved the building in
			# the queue for want of raw materials, which is the one thing the owner
			# forbade outright («не должно... смещён в очереди из-за этого»,
			# 2026-09-01, confirmed 2026-09-02). The floor still chooses the method --
			# that is the half of his rule that stands: «может влиять только на ВЫБОР
			# метода производства в конкретном домике».
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm1 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	# **Три числа обо всей земле, и «Расширить» наращивает их, а не считает
	# заново.** Обходы ниже идут по `_candidates`, а доливка подставляет туда
	# только новые локации: обнуление здесь стёрло бы вклад старой земли, и
	# доля вышла бы посчитанной по одной земле Y. `_ng` и `_nrgo` -- счётчики,
	# так что «не обнулять» и есть «продолжить счёт»; `_pbest` -- максимум, и
	# сравнение ниже само оставляет больший.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor1 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest1 value = 0 }
	}
	# **Counted on the side the location actually is**, and not on the better of
	# the two: a good whose only buildings are rural would otherwise count as
	# makeable on ground that is all towns. The
	# thirty-sixth run is what that costs -- five towns of Münsterland reported
	# «товаров 13» where at most eight could ever stand there, and the quota is
	# divided by that number, so every good's share came out too small.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm1 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm1 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		# **И на какой стороне — раздельно.** Комнаты города и села не
		# смешиваются: товар, который умеет только в городе, не может взять
		# сельскую комнату, сколько бы их ни было. Доля, посчитанная одним
		# котлом, обещает ему то, чего земля не имеет.
		#
		# **`_ng` -- сумма этих двух, а не «где товар может появиться».** Товар,
		# у которого своих зданий нет ни на одной стороне, из корзины выпадает
		# целиком, как шёлк: земля его не делает. Рыба, 2026-09-08: «она должна
		# уйти вообще из этой корзины ровно как там нет шёлка. Мы смотрим на
		# домики, которые можно сделать, а рыба нынче такой не является».
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm1 = 83 } }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr1 add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng1 add = 1 }
			}
		}
		# **And the best this ground ever pays this good**, which is what the open
		# ladder deals the leftovers by. Taken on the side the location actually is,
		# inside the walk that was happening anyway: one comparison a candidate and
		# no walk of its own. The dump has printed this number as `o` all along --
		# read back off the map afterwards -- and afterwards is too late to
		# allocate with.
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p1 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest1
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest1 value = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr1 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest1
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest1 value = var:bag_wtp_pr1 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:clay }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo1 add = 1 }
		# **РГО тоже по сторонам.** Скидка «одно РГО — один домик» вычитается из
		# квоты, а квоты теперь две: РГО в селе не должен уменьшать городскую
		# квоту товара, и наоборот.
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot1 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor1 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	# **Nothing is normalized any more, and the pass that did it is gone.** The
	# gain is already the same question for every good -- what fraction of this
	# recipe's own ceiling this ground pays -- so the ordered walk that used to
	# find each good's best on the ground, once per good, is 47 walks saved.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng1 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# coal: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for

# `_ng2` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the

	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm2 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor2 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest2 value = 0 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm2 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm2 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt2 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng2 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 138 var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 139 var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 140 var:bag_wtp_prm2 = 141 } }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr2 add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng2 add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p2 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest2
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest2 value = var:bag_wtp_p2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr2 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest2
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest2 value = var:bag_wtp_pr2 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:coal }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo2 add = 1 }
		if = {

		}

	if = {

		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}

# cotton: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by
# the better of them, so that 1000 means "the location this good wants most" for
# every good alike. A good nothing here can make stays at zero and never picks.
#
# `_ng3` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_3 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm3 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor3 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest3 value = 0 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm3 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm3 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng3 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm3 = 142 } }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr3 add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng3 add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p3 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest3
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest3 value = var:bag_wtp_p3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr3 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest3
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest3 value = var:bag_wtp_pr3 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:cotton }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo3 add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot3 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor3 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng3 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# `_ng25` is how many candidates could hold it at all, which is what the
# tiers in `bag_wtp_plan_allocate` order the goods by.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_harvest_25 = {
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_by_end }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm25 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor25 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest25 value = 0 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm25 > 0
				}
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
					var:bag_wtp_prm25 > 0
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt25 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng25 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 665 var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 666 var:bag_wtp_prm25 = 667 } }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr25 add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng25 add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p25 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest25
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest25 value = var:bag_wtp_p25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr25 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest25
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest25 value = var:bag_wtp_pr25 }
		}
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = { raw_material = goods:wool }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo25 add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot25 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor25 add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng25 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# fine_cloth: keep both sides and the method that won each, then divide the ground by

			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm30 value = var:bag_wtp_pendbest_method_r }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm30 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p30 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_t }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm30 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_t }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_prm30 = 0 }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr30 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanygain_r }
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm30 value = var:bag_wtp_pendanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_p30 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pm30 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_t }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pr30 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowgain_r }
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm30 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowbest_method_r }

				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_prm30 value = var:bag_wtp_pnowanybest_method_r }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_ext } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng30 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt30 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr30 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgo30 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgot30 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_nrgor30 value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest30 value = 0 }
	}
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
					var:bag_wtp_pm30 > 0
				}

		else = {

				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr30 add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng30 add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p30 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest30
			}

		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr30 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest30
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest30 value = var:bag_wtp_pr30 }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng30 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}

				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngt44 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng44 add = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 553 var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 554 var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 557 var:bag_wtp_prm44 = 558 } }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ngr44 add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_ng44 add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = yes
				var:bag_wtp_p44 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest44
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest44 value = var:bag_wtp_p44 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				bag_wtp_plan_is_town = no
				var:bag_wtp_pr44 > global_var:bag_wtp_pbest44
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pbest44 value = var:bag_wtp_pr44 }
		}
	}

	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_ng44 > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_scored add = 1 }
	}
}

# One good, into the location in hand.
#
# **Guarded, and asked the same question the ordered walk used as its `limit`**,
# so the urban-rights round can call this on its own without repeating a word --
# and so a right whose second good wants a building the first took is simply not
# given it.
#
# The building goes into a list beside the good, because that is what a location
# can only hold one of. Which building it is comes off the method the harvest
# kept.
# clay, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_1 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout1 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt1 add = 1 }
			# **И сколько комнат занято на этой стороне.** Сухой круг поднимает
			# долю только той стороны, где ещё есть куда ставить: сторон две, и
			# растить их вместе значило растить городскую долю ради сельских
			# комнат — на северной Германии это давало потолок 20 там, где товар
			# доходил до 18.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p1` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# clay, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_1 = yes
			# **The one invariant, asked again at the last moment.** A location holds
			# `cap` buildings and no more. The walk frees the room before it places,
			# so this passes by the time it is read -- and on 2026-09-04 it did not:
			# 27 buildings went in over the cap, one location reaching 18 of 4, with
			# nothing evicted at all. Whatever the walk got wrong, **a placement that
			# cannot say no is a plan that can be corrupted**, and the diagnostics'
			# `EDIT walk` line says which of the two failed.
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm1 = 83 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout1 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:clay }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:clay_pit }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt1 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p1 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p1 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# coal, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:

# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_3 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_3 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 142
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm3 = 142 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout3 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cotton }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cotton_plantation }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt3 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p3` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p3 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p3 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# fiber_crops, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_5 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_5 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 156
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 156 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout5 add = 80 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fiber_crops_farm }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn5 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt5 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p5` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p5 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p5 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 157
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm5 = 157 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout5 add = 50 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fiber_crops }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn5 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt5 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn50 add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p5 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p5 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# fiber_crops, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика

# fruit, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_7 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_7 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 284
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 284 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout7 add = 30 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:fruit_orchard }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn7 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt7 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p7` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p7 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p7 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 285
				var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 286
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 285 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout7 add = 117 } }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm7 = 286 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout7 add = 54 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:fruit }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:nd_irq_nakhil_grove }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn7 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt7 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p7 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p7 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# incense, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_9 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_9 = yes
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm9 = 309
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm9 = 309 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout9 add = 26 } }

# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt16 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p16` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p16 }

				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p16 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt16 add = 1 }

		if = {

			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:saltpeter }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt16 add = 1 }

# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#

# silk, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a

# stone, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_20 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_20 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 561
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 561 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 50 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn50 add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p20` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p20 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 562
				var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 563
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 562 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 50 } }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 563 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:stone_quarry }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p20 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# stone, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_20 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_20 = yes
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 561
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 561 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 50 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:shoen }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bn50 add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p20 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 562
				var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 563
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 562 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 50 } }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm20 = 563 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout20 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:stone }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:stone_quarry }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt20 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p20 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p20 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

bag_wtp_plan_try_town_22 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_22 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm22 = 574
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm22 = 574 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout22 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tobacco }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tobacco_plantation }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn22 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt22 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p22` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p22 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p22 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# tobacco, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_22 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_22 = yes
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm22 = 574
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm22 = 574 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout22 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:tobacco }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:tobacco_plantation }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn22 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt22 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p22 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p22 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# cloth, town side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_plan_try_town_29 = {
	if = {
		limit = { bag_wtp_plan_can_town_29 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 84
				var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 85
				var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 86
			} }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 84 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout29 add = 100 } }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 85 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout29 add = 80 } }
			if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 86 } change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pout29 add = 100 } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_goods target = goods:cloth }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_builds target = building_type:cloth_guild }
			change_variable = { name = bag_wtp_load add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_placed add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_added add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pn29 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_pnt29 add = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pt add = 1 }

			# **What this building gets out of standing here**, which is the question
			# the owner asked of the whole plan on 2026-09-02: «какой процент из них
			# получит выгоду от своего положения на карте». `_p29` is the
			# gain -- the fraction of this recipe's own ceiling the ground pays, out
			# of 1000 -- so the two counters are «how many earn anything» and
			# «what they earn on average». Two adds a placement and nothing per
			# candidate: the plan does not get slower for being answerable.
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_gain add = var:bag_wtp_p29 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:bag_wtp_p29 > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_fed add = 1 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 87
				var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 88
				var:bag_wtp_pm29 = 89

# cloth, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# fine_cloth, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_edit_place_town_30 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			bag_wtp_edit_fits_town_30 = yes
			var:bag_wtp_load < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban
		}
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_pm30 = 158
				var:bag_wtp_pm30 = 159
				var:bag_wtp_pm30 = 160
				var:bag_wtp_pm30 = 161

#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:

# furniture, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location

# glass, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.

# leather, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# masonry, town side, **for the editor**.

# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a

# paper, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# porcelain, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.

# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#

# steel, town side, **for the editor**.
#
# **The same placement, asked a different question.** `_plan_can_*` is the plan's
# gate and it asks for a free room; the editor frees the room itself, an eviction
# at a time, so it asks `_edit_fits_*` -- the identical test with the room clause
# taken out. **The scan and the placement are then one predicate**, and cannot
# disagree: the walk chose this location *because* `_edit_fits_*` said yes, so a
# placement that then refuses is impossible by construction.
#
# The owner, 2026-09-04, after «поставить не удалось, и всё осталось как было»:
# «Там не должно быть вообще никаких ограничений и правил, кроме как что 1 домика
# не может быть меньше 1 и собственно самих правил наивыгоднейшей
# установки/удаления.» This is that, and the room is the walk's business.
# Scope: location
