	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot35 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn35 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot35 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo35 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short35 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq35 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short35 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn35 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short35 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot36 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot36 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo36 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short36 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq36 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short36 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn36 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short36 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot37 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn37 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot37 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo37 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short37 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq37 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short37 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn37 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short37 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot38 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn38 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot38 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo38 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short38 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq38 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short38 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn38 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short38 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot39 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn39 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot39 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo39 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short39 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq39 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short39 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn39 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short39 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot40 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn40 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot40 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo40 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short40 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq40 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short40 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn40 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short40 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot41 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn41 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot41 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo41 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short41 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq41 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short41 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn41 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short41 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot42 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn42 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot42 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo42 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short42 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq42 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short42 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn42 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short42 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot43 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn43 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot43 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo43 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short43 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq43 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short43 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn43 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short43 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot44 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn44 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot44 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo44 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short44 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq44 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short44 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn44 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short44 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot45 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot45 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo45 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short45 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq45 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short45 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn45 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short45 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot46 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn46 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot46 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo46 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short46 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq46 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short46 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn46 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short46 max = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot47 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pn47 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_tot47 add = global_var:bag_wtp_nrgo47 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short47 value = global_var:bag_wtp_pq47 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short47 subtract = global_var:bag_wtp_pn47 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_short47 max = 0 }

	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count value = 0 }
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_load }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count add = var:bag_wtp_load }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_load value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_count }
		# **And how many of its locations the plan uses**, for the province row
		# of the folded list. Counted in the walk that is already standing in
		# the province rather than in a second one.
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count value = 0 }
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_load var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count add = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locn value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_count }
	}
	# **Области сперва, провинции внутри области — и это одно место, а не два.**
	# Его слова 2026-09-06: «провинции должны идти по списку внутри своих
	# областей… я не хочу, чтобы провинции разных областей были в перемешку».
	# Порядок один на оба вида списка: `_plan_prank` несёт его целиком, и плоский
	# список читает то же число, что свёрнутый.
	#
	# **Без упаковки двух ключей в одно число.** Область и загрузка провинции
	# влезли бы в одно `order_by`, но предел фиксированной точки движка отсюда
	# неизвестен — предупреждение об этом уже стоит при `_plan_order`. Вместо
	# этого обход внутри обхода: области по своей загрузке, внутри каждой
	# провинции по своей, и номер выдаётся по ходу.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_area_load value = 0 }
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_area_locs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		save_scope_as = bag_wtp_plan_prov_at
		# **«Эту область уже видели?» -- через глобалку, потому что внутренний обход
		# не может писать в скоуп, из которого его позвали.** Список областей короток
		# (у него шестнадцать провинций на пять областей), так что квадрат здесь
		# дешевле любого хитрого способа.
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_aseen value = 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_plan_area_locs
			limit = { area = scope:bag_wtp_plan_prov_at.area }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_aseen value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_aseen = 0 }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_area_locs target = this }
		}
	}
	# Сколько домиков во всей области -- по этому числу области и встанут.
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_area_locs
		save_scope_as = bag_wtp_plan_area_at
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count value = 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
			limit = { area = scope:bag_wtp_plan_area_at.area }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_count add = var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_load }
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_area_load value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_count }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_n value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_area_locs
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_area_order
		max = 600
		check_range_bounds = no
		save_scope_as = bag_wtp_plan_area_at
		ordered_in_global_list = {
			variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
			limit = { area = scope:bag_wtp_plan_area_at.area }
			order_by = bag_wtp_plan_prov_order
			max = 600
			check_range_bounds = no
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prov_n add = 1 }
			province_definition = {
				every_location_in_province_definition = {
					limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_prank }
					set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_prank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_n }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Counted before the rows are taken and separately from them: the walk below
	# stops at 1500, and a count that stopped with it would say the plan
	# used exactly as many locations as the window can keep, whatever it really
	# used.
	#
	# **And it walks `_plan_touched`, not `_candidates`.** The two are the same
	# list for a plan just run -- the reset puts every candidate in it -- but a slot
	# loaded from the editor puts a plan back on ground the picker may no longer
	# hold, and walking the picker would then rank nothing while the map mode
	# painted the plan. A plan is ranked over the ground it stands on.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_load > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_found add = 1 }
	}
	# **The rows are ranked whole and drawn a page at a time.** The datamodel is
	# what costs, so the window still holds 150 rows at once -- but the plan
	# has always used more ground than that, and cutting the list at the window's
	# capacity is what made «показано всего 150 локаций» look like the answer
	# stopping short. Every location keeps its place in the whole order and the page
	# it falls on; the page buttons choose which of them the datamodel gets.
	#
	# The page is counted here rather than divided out afterwards: the counter is
	# reset and the page stepped whenever a page fills, so the comparison is against
	# a literal and there is no rounding to be wrong about.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pages value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pagec value = 0 }
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_touched
		# **Житница остаётся в списке.** Его слово, 2026-09-09: «не удаляй из
		# списка в плане локацию которая помечена как житница, я ожидаю, что в
		# плане она будет просто помечена значком житницы и просто не будет
		# указано никаких своих зданий». Домиков у неё ноль, и без этой оговорки
		# ряд бы не выпал -- он бы просто не появился.
		limit = {
			OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_load > 0
				bag_wtp_is_granary = yes
			}
		}
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_order
		max = 1500
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_shown add = 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pagec add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_pagec > 150 }
			set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pagec value = 1 }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pages add = 1 }
		}
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pg value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_pages }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_ranked target = this }
	}
	# A new plan always opens on its first page; the old one's page may not exist.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_page value = 1 }
}

# The window's own list, filled on opening and emptied on closing -- the same
# contract as the other two windows and for the same reason: a scripted widget
# never comes down, so emptying the datamodel is the only thing that frees a row.
#
# **One page of it, and the page bar says which.** `_plan_pg` was written on the
# location by the walk above, so choosing a page is one comparison per ranked
# location and no arithmetic at all -- the same shape as `var:bag_wtp_load <
# global_var:bag_wtp_plan_cap_urban`, which is the plan's own gate.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_show = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_page } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_page value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bag_wtp_plan_pages } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_pages value = 1 }
	}
	# **Clamped with an `if` and not with `min`/`max`.** `change_variable`'s
	# `max = 1` is a floor -- `_plan_quota` above depends on it and says so -- but
	# which way `min` runs is an inference and not a measurement, and getting it
	# backwards here would jump the window to the last page on every open with
	# nothing in any log to say why. A comparison between two globals is the form
	# this file already lives on.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_page < 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_page value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_page > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_pages }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_page value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_pages }
	}
	# The rows this page covers, for the bar above the table: it is the answer to
	# «показано 150 из скольких» and it has to be readable without a log.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_from value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_page }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_from subtract = 1 }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_from multiply = 150 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_to value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_from }
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_to add = 150 }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_to > global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
		set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_to value = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_shown }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_from add = 1 }
	# The bar itself is only drawn where there is more than one page, and a country
	# variable is the one thing a `visible` can ask about without a data function.
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_pages > 1 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_paged value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_plan_paged
	}
	# **The folded list, and it is a second list rather than a second shape for
	# the first.** A datamodel item sees one scope, so a province row and a
	# location row cannot be the same row -- and the flat list is what he has
	# been reading since the plan existed, so it stays untouched and the fold is
	# a switch beside it.
	#
	# One representative location a province (`_plan_prov_locs` already holds
	# exactly that), ordered by the province's own place, and the province's
	# locations are drawn under it from `GetProvinceDefinition.GetLocations` --
	# the same nesting the search window has used since it was built.
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provfill value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provshown value = 0 }
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_provs
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locn var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_locn > 0 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provfill add = 1 }
	}
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locs
		limit = { has_variable = bag_wtp_plan_prov_locn var:bag_wtp_plan_prov_locn > 0 }
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_pseq_order
		max = 150
		check_range_bounds = no
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provshown add = 1 }
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_provs target = this }
	}
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_plan_ranked
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_plan_pg = global_var:bag_wtp_plan_page }
		order_by = bag_wtp_plan_rank_order
		max = 150
		check_range_bounds = no
		add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_plan_results target = this }
	}
}

# One page forward and one back, from the two buttons beside the page number.
# **Neither re-plans anything**: the answer is already ranked and every location
# knows its page, so a page turn is one walk over the ranked list.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_page_next_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_page < global_var:bag_wtp_plan_pages }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_page add = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_page_prev_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:bag_wtp_plan_page > 1 }
		change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_page subtract = 1 }
		bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	}
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_plan_hide = {
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_results
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_plan_provs
	# **Сводка уходит вместе с планом, который её породил.** Она открывается
	# иконкой из окна плана и отвечает про этот план; оставшись висеть после
	# того, как окно закрыли, она отвечала бы про него же, но выглядела бы как
	# ответ про то, что на экране сейчас.
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_sum_open
}

# The same thing the window's own scripted GUI does, reachable from an effect,
# because a Mod Menu button is script and script cannot reach the interface's
# variable system.
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_open_plan_window_effect = {
	bag_wtp_sel_restore_plan = yes
	bag_wtp_plan_show = yes
	# **Галочки CM он мог трогать и сам**, по одной в панели локации, поэтому
	# подсветка кнопок отмашки пересчитывается на каждом открытии окна, а не
	# только после своего же нажатия.
	bag_wtp_cm_light = yes
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_result_open
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_right_open
	bag_wtp_hide_results = yes
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_plan_open value = 1 }
}
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_init_vbt = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vbt1 value = building_type:fishing_village }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vbt2 value = building_type:forest_village }
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_vbt3 value = building_type:market_village }
}
